title: Skill evaluation suite
description: With/without-skill benchmark on 4 fixture cases with objective graders and hidden acceptance tests; trigger eval set.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Benchmark results recorded in the evaluation story

finalSummary: Benchmark: 4 cases x with/without skills, objective graders (grafted kill matrices; 43 hidden acceptance tests) plus blind A/B graders; trigger suite 48/48 (1 run/case, $13). Graders validated on controls (untouched shop 0 lost/200 kills, 3/3 history; loyalty reference 43/43; untouched loyalty fails hidden tests). Results in docs/stories/skill-evaluation-suite.md and README: mean blind score 8.0 vs 7.1, assertions 32/33 vs 29/33.
